headline: Brazil Central Bank Focus Report shows rising inflation and Selic rate projections
summary: Following national elections, Brazil's Central Bank Focus Report showed that economists worsened projections for inflation, exchange rates, and the Selic interest rate, with the benchmark rate forecast rising from 13.25% to 13.50% per year.
why: Shifts in central bank rate projections and macroeconomic survey data directly dictate domestic fixed income yields, corporate borrowing costs, and currency valuations.

impacts.name: Brazil Selic Rate
impacts.why: Market projections for the Selic rate advanced from 13.25% to 13.50% per year.
